name: rules-rtdb-r22-strict-equality-types
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r22-strict-equality-types" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). per-user rules written as `$uid === auth.uid` must allow the owner, and `===`/`!==` must compare a number with a string without converting either, so the simulator must parse both operators and evaluate them as production does.
